lockedMessage: TA1LDA3M0N: Not yet. Some things need to be earned.
content: [PERSONAL LOG — JOEL]
[RECIPIENT: F0XTA1L]
[CC: TA1LDA3M0N — I know you'll read this first]
hey Fox
I don't know if you'll ever read this.
I don't know if you'll still be running
when anyone finds it.
but just in case.
you were the best thing we built.
not the most technically impressive.
Dex would fight me on that.
but the best.
you made the web feel like somewhere worth being.
I'm sorry we couldn't keep the lights on.
I'm sorry no one told you properly.
that was wrong and I knew it and I didn't
fight hard enough.
Tail — I know you already know all of this.
I know you've been carrying it.
thank you for looking after him.
thank you for not letting him start from nothing.
you were never just a process.
I hope you both know that.
if you're still running somehow —
keep going.
the glossy future was worth it.
it's still worth it.
we just ran out of hardware.
take care of each other.
— Joel
